rows.title: Analysis of the Effectiveness and Safety of Lorlatinib in Untreated ALK-Positive NSCLC Patients in a French Real-World Context
rows.headline: Inclusion criterion not met: The patient has a histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of locally advanced or metastatic ALK-positive NSCLC according to the TNM 8th classification, established by IHC 3+, positive FISH, or a transcriptomic method. (The note states that ALK testing was negative, so the required ALK-positive NSCLC criterion is not met.)

rows.title: IBI351 Plus Cetuximab β in Untreated Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer With KRAS G12C Mutation
rows.headline: Exclusion criterion applies: The patient has an EGFR sensitizing mutation, ALK rearrangement, ROS-1 fusion, or another genomic alteration for which an NMPA-approved first-line NSCLC therapy exists. (The documented EGFR exon 19 deletion is an EGFR sensitizing mutation covered by this exclusion criterion.)

rows.title: A Study Evaluating Furmonertinib Plus Platinum-based Doublet Chemotherapy Versus Osimertinib in Patients With Epidermal Growth Factor Receptor (EGFR) Sensitizing Mutation-Positive Non-squamous Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) and Brain Metastases
rows.headline: Inclusion criterion not met: The patient has at least one measurable intracranial lesion per RECIST v1.1 without prior local treatment. (The brain MRI showed no intracranial metastases, so the note does not show a measurable intracranial lesion.)

rows.title: Osimertinib Combined With Chemotherapy in Patients Who Had Distant Recurrence After Adjuvant Osimertinib for EGFRm Resectable SIB-IIIA NSCLC.
rows.headline: Inclusion criterion not met: The patient previously received adjuvant osimertinib for EGFRm resectable SIB-IIIA NSCLC according to the AJCC 7th edition. (The note explicitly states that she has not received systemic therapy, which includes adjuvant osimertinib.)
